title: auth
description: Result of a successful `stride auth`. The paste-the-code instructions are NOT here and never on stdout in JSON mode (#259) — they go to stderr, which carries no contract, because stdout carries this envelope. Tokens are never returned: `auth` stores them in the db and `config get` refuses to read them back, so returning them here would be the one command that undoes that.

expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the stored access token expires. The one fact a caller can act on — `sync` refreshes automatically, so this is when to expect that to happen, not a deadline to meet.
